Knowledge is Power

Education Projects

Teach English, mathematics, or other subjects in local schools. Help with after-school programs and educational activities for children of all ages.

Inquire About Education —
Healing Hands

Healthcare Projects

Assist in local clinics and health centers. Support medical professionals, participate in health education campaigns, and help improve community health.

Inquire About Healthcare —
Protecting Heritage

Conservation Projects

Work on wildlife conservation, reforestation, and environmental education projects. Help protect Tanzania's incredible natural heritage.

Development Projects

The Journey

Orientation

Thorough cultural training, language basics, and project guidance.

Local Living

Immersive experience living with local families or volunteer houses.

Sustainable Support

Fees directly support the communities you serve for long-term impact.

Full Support

In-country team available 24/7 to support your journey.

Cultural Events

Participate in local community events and learn Swahili.

Certificate

Receive a certificate of completion acknowledging your contribution.

Requirements

  • Minimum age: 18 years old
  • Basic English proficiency
  • Flexibility and cultural sensitivity
  • Commitment to minimum program duration
  • Clean criminal background check

What's Included

  • Airport pickup and orientation
  • Accommodation and meals
  • In-country support
  • Project placement and supervision
  • Certificate of completion
